post.topic: Automating Student Session Reminders and Resource Delivery for Coaching Institutes
post.headline: Stop losing hours to *manual admin* in coaching.
post.subline: Automatically send session reminders, prep worksheets, and Zoom links directly to your students on WhatsApp.
post.caption:
Are your coaches spending more time managing calendars than actually coaching?

Manual booking confirmation, sending pre-session workbooks, and tracking missed appointments drain your institute's resources.

An AI automation workflow fixes this instantly.

When a client books a slot, your system sends a WhatsApp confirmation, syncs Google Calendar, and delivers prep materials 24 hours prior.

Post-session feedback and homework triggers automatically.

Quick tip: Set up an automated WhatsApp reminder 2 hours before calls to cut student no-shows by half.
